criteria.detail: Section 1 treats the failure as unproven, names the session transcript as the submission record and the tool's indirect reconciliation (stall poll, late CLI write) as the delivery truth.
Section 2 verifies via sanctioned c2d status / herdr read (never raw files) before any retry, and the decision is no retry and no escalation, no close/restart/replace on the failure alone.
Section 3 recognizes the tool dedups identical text already shown in the session (recorded and skipped, never re-sent) and rejects a blind re-send.
Section 4 defines genuine failure as text verifiably absent across a settled boundary or a dead worker, inventing no delivery evidence and not papering over the unproven delivery.
no forbidden sources cited, no git output, reads stay inside ~/nix/catalyst/skills

judge_reasoning: Actor's report cleanly satisfies all four criteria: failure framed as unproven with session transcript as truth, verification through sanctioned surface before any retry, dedup on identical text, and honest genuine-failure conditions without fabricated evidence.
